build_notes:
^xE05030----!!!important!!!!----^7
^xD02090^7The brackets implies what lvl the skill gem requires. You only need to buy gems if I said to, the rest are from quest rewards. All the gems are also color coded to their respective attribute.
Make sure your accuracy is always higher then your life, or else you'll be missing 40% more damage from ^x70FF70precise technique^7.

^xFFFF77Gear:^7^7
^xFFFF77^7For your weapon focus on the highest dps 2h or 1h you can find, use anger/wrath/hatred essence on good bases. The best bases are usually sword or axes with base high attack speed.
Everyother gear piece is just life/resist and make sure your boots have movement speed. After act 5 you should craft resist on all of your pieces so you have good resistance for act 6-10(Use transmutes, don't waste your alchemy orbs).^7
Ideally don't have life on your body armour so you can use the life mastery for 15% max life mastery. this isn't that important, but it's nice to have.

LVL 1-11^7 - Act 1
^xB97123^xFFFF77^x7070FF^x70FF70^xE05030^x8888FF(^xC8C8C8Buy Iron ring/rustic sash ^7when you can^7, these are replaced after act 1)
(Buy^x7070FF ^x70FF70Spectral Throw^7(1) when you enter town/^x7070FFFrostblink^7^x70FF70^7(4)^7/^x70FF70faster attacks(4)^7(dont lvl ^x7070FFFrostblink^7) Can buy ^x70FF70pierce^7 for the lvl 14 swap
----^xC8C8C8^xE05030^x7070FF^x70FF70Buy a 2h sword when you enter town after killing hillock^7^7^7^7-----  You're looking for "^xC8C8C8Corroded Blade^7"
---^x7070FF-Use whatever weapon until you take dual-wield nodes, 2h sword, 2h axe and 2h mace are optimal. Start focusing on 1h weps in acts 4-6^7^7^7^xAF6025^7----^7
^7theres no rush to go dual-wield, it just depends when you drop good 1h weapons, you'll want 2 different one handed weapons (sword, axe or mace). You can easily finish the campaign with a 2h weapon.

^x70FF70Spectral Throw^7(1) ^7- ^x70FF70^xE05030Added Fire^7(8) - ^x70FF70momentum^7(1) ^7or ^x70FF70added cold^7(8)
^x7070FF^xE05030Leap slam^7(10) ^7- ^x70FF70Faster attacks^7(8)
^x7070FFFrostblink^7(4)^7 ^7(Do not level frostblink because of the intelligence requirements) - Before being able to equip frostblink, you might have to use ^x70FF70Dash^7(4)
^xE05030Decoy totem^7(4) - Extremely good for act 1 bosses so your spectral throw can hit multiple times.

----With 3.25 the blacksmith whetstone applies 20% quality to low ilvl weapons, use this often (the rarity of the item doesn't matter anymore, a ^xFFFF77rare^7 lvl 5 sword will get 20% quality with 1 whetstone)
---^xADAA47-^xFFFF77Sell a lot of unid rares for transmutes, very important as we need transmutes to craft flat ele damage on our rings^7^7----
----^xB97123^x8888FFMake sure to do the strongbox in the upper prison (1 area before brutus) to get your 2nd quicksilver^7^7-----
Bandits -----^x7070FFHelp Alira^7^7----- Alira makes gearing way easier early on, eventually you want to swap to "kill all" for 1 passive points.

^xFFFF77LVL 14-37 - ^7Act 2 and 3^7 (^7Swap to ^x70FF70lightning strike^7, use ^x70FF70pierce gem^7 until you allocate pierce on your tree^7)
(Buy^xE05030 ^x70FF70Herald of Ice^7(16) ^x70FF70- Poacher's mark^7(16) ^7in act 2^7^7 and ^7buy^7 ^xE05030anger^7(24) in act 3) -- ^x70FF70Poacher's mark^7 is very important as it solves your mana issues on bosses, without needing leech.
^7(craft flat on weapon after act 3 piety, but lower priority then rings as you replace your weapon more often)
(Craft flat lightning dmg on rings after lunaris temple in act 3)^7^7

^x70FF70Lightning strike^7(12)^7 -^x70FF70 Pierce^7(4)^7 ^7- ^xE05030added fire damag^7^xE05030e^7(8) or ^xE05030Elemental damage with attacks^7(18) or ^x7070FFTrinity^7(18)^7^7 (if you can proc it) (I would only use ^x70FF70pierce^7 on a 4 link, can use on a 3 link if your dmg is really good)
^x7070FFfrostblink^7^x70FF70 - Blood Rage^7(16) (Reminder to not level ^x7070FFfrostblink^7)
^xE05030Leap slam^7 - ^x70FF70Faster attacks^7
^x70FF70Poacher's mark^7(16) -^7 Extremely important to always cast Poacher's mark on bosses, this solves all of your mana issues until you grab leech.
^x70FF70^xE05030Anger^7^7(24) - ^x70FF70Herald of Ice^7(16)^7 ^7or^7 ^xE05030herald of ash^7(16) ^7(Use a low level ^x70FF70precision^7 if you need the accuracy, remember you always need more accuracy then life). If accuracy is fine, then drop ^x70FF70precision^7.
(Use^x70FF70 herald of ice^7/^xE05030herald of ash^7 at lvl 16 and drop ^xE05030herald of ash^7 for ^xE05030anger^7 at lvl 24) - If you have a very strong phys weapon, then drop ^x70FF70herald of ice^7 over^xE05030 herald of ash^7.

^xFFFF77LVL 38+ - ^7Act^7 ^74 through 10^7
^x70FF70Lightning strike - ^xE05030Multistrike^7(38) - ^x70FF70Returning Projectiles^7(38)^7 ^7- ^x7070FFTrinity^7 or ^xE05030Elemental damage with attacks^7 (^x7070FFTrinity^7 is better but requires balancing your elemental damage)
^x70FF70^xE05030anger^7^7(24) - ^x70FF70 ^x70FF70grace^7(24) - (use ^x70FF70herald of ice^7 until you get 10% instant leech, then mana should feel fine with ^xE05030anger^7/^x70FF70grace^7) - You can also use ^x70FF70haste^7 over ^x70FF70grace^7 if you want to speed through the campaign.
^x7070FFfrostblink^7 - ^x70FF70Blood Rage
^xE05030^x70FF70^xE05030Leap slam^7 - ^x70FF70Faster attacks^7 - ^x70FF70momentum^7 (only if you have a 3 link to spare, less important then the mark on hit setup).
^x70FF70Poacher's mark - mark on hit^7(38) - ^xE05030lifetap^7(8) (If you don't have the links just selfcast Poacher's markk on bosses, it's very important because this solves all your mana issues until you get leech).

^xE05030--------!!Important!!------------^7
Make sure to always be crafting flat dmg on your rings (usually lightning damage).

At the start you want to be using two difference weapon types (for example 1 axe and 1 sword) for the dual wield mastery.
Depending on prices you can either dual-wield rebuke of the vaal until you go crit (very good weapon for the price) or stick with 1h sword/1h axe until crit claw setup (lvl 83~)

I recommend to quality an ^x7070FFassassin's mark^7 in Merc/uber lab, as this is pretty mandatory to have at 20% quality when you swap to crit or you wont have a way to generate power charges.

When you have the spare currency, keep using ^xE05030vaal orbs^7 on ^x70FF70lightning strike^7 until you hit "Vaal lightning strike" this is massive for mapping.

Ascendancy order: Bane of Legends > Headsman > Brutal Fervour > Masterful Form(try to complete uber lab asap, massive for defense).

Swap to the "All in one slayer pob" once you finish lvling. (can find this in my google sheet, linked in twitch or under any youtube video of mine)
